name: Hy-SimulMT-30B-A3B (and Interleave)

lineage.how_derived: speech-capable HYV3 MoE (HYV3SpeechForCausalLM) trained for simultaneous translation; base checkpoint not named on the card

purpose: Real-time simultaneous speech translation between Chinese and English for live settings (meetings, speeches, interviews): translates while the speaker talks, outputs translated text and, with an external TTS service, speech with real-time voice cloning (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0 (Tencent LICENSE.txt)
license.notes: LICENSE.txt in the HF repo read: states Hy-SimulMT (code, parameters, weights) is Apache-2.0 except listed third-party components; full Apache-2.0 text follows. No territory exclusion found in the head of the file (checked by keyword search for European, Territory, Korea: no hits).

architecture.kind: speech-input MoE decoder (HYV3SpeechForCausalLM, audio encoder in config)
architecture.attention: GQA 32 heads / 4 KV heads, head_dim 128, QK norm

variants.notes: translation-only output; sum of repo files incl. assets
Q8_0 33.31 GB; needs the vendor's llama.cpp PR #31198
source text and translation output; Q8_0 33.31 GB

pc-12gb.notes: 19.7 GB: MoE with 3B active, experts in RAM

pc-16gb.notes: experts offloaded to RAM, about 3B active parameters

mac-16-24gb.notes: 19.7 GB against 12 or 22 GB GPU share

other: vLLM >= 0.31 with HYV3ForCausalLM support plus the simulst package (SimulInfer, NVIDIA CUDA)
SimulInfer service with WebSocket realtime API
engine_support.notes: Card: architecture-specific llama.cpp support submitted as PR #31198 (not verified merged by us). The card's own SimulInfer deployment is Linux with NVIDIA GPU; the FP8, GGUF and Interleave checkpoints are not covered by its speech-output integration.

benchmarks.name: StreamLAAL on RealSI long-form audio
benchmarks.harness: lowest of the systems in the card figure

benchmarks.name: Speech translation score FLEURS
benchmarks.harness: card table, metric not named in text (GEMBA used for long-form)

benchmarks.name: Speech translation score RealSI-Sentence
benchmarks.harness: highest of all listed systems incl. commercial APIs

strengths: Card reports lower lag than the compared open-source and commercial systems at competitive quality
Matched small test (18 recordings) against CATTI level 1 and 2 interpreters: builder reports quality on par and often lower latency
weaknesses: Chinese-English only for speech translation; card language list names 36 languages for text
Card comparison table lists Qwen3.8-LiveTranslate ahead on CoVoST2 (82.1 vs 75.5)
Speech output and voice cloning need a separate TTS service
avoid_for: German or other European speech translation (not offered)
soft.maturity: Tencent Hunyuan, first release 2026-10-26 with SimulInfer and SimulTrain code.

tona_fit.reason: Only Chinese-English speech translation; no German use case. Kept as a record of what streaming translation with a speech-capable MoE looks like (A3B, 19.7 GB at Q4).
blockers: Hunyuan V3 speech architecture not in Tona
llama.cpp support is an open PR per card
